correctness.rationale: Differentiate log Psi(s) including B'(s): Psi'/Psi = -q(s/c)/(c(1+s/c)^2), and omega1=-Psi'(1/h)/h; differentiating q gives q'(x)=(x+1)(ax-b)/x^2 with unique global minimizer x=b/a and q→+infinity at both endpoints. Hence 0/1/2 simple positive roots depending on Theta and precise sign intervals for all h. Strictly increasing Psi on [s_-,s_+] rules out a nonnegative inverse Laplace kernel; positivity of Psi rules out an all-nonpositive kernel under existence/integrability premise from prior Scarpi theory. Any positive SOE transform F(s)=sum p_j/(s+lambda_j) is decreasing, so endpoint triangle inequality gives error >=(Psi(s_+)-Psi(s_-))/2, and F_lambda=M*lambda/(s+lambda) attains the limit. Taylor near the nondegenerate minimum yields square-root opening. Independent high-precision root bracket and derivative/omega probes for a=0.2,b=0.8,c=10 reproduce Theta≈-0.2133276725 and the negative first lag.
